unit.why: A short narrative frame (during R. Yitzchak Isaac's last illness the Sanzer rebbe wrote to him) introduces a quoted letter. It is the opening episode of the account of the tzaddik's final illness.
unit.boundary_note: The death narrative continues into the next division (לא), which tells of his last illness and death after Shavuot 1872.

stories.start_quote: בעת חליו האחרון בין פסח לעצרת
stories.summary_en: During R. Yitzchak Isaac of Zydaczow's final illness, R. Hayyim Halberstam of Sanz writes him a grieving letter. He urges him to pray for himself and for Israel, and declares that the people rely on his righteousness and his ancestors' merit.

quotes: כתב אליו מרן הגאוה״ק איש אלקים אור החיים זצוקללה״ה מצאנז
ואנו נשענים על צדקתו וזכות אבותיו הקדושים
כי הגיע מכאוב גדול לנשיא ישראל
tags.why: Israel depends on the tzaddik's merit and leadership

quotes: ולבקש רחמים על עצמו וירחם ויחמול
